title: Minecraft Dungeons II
provenance: Reported by magnipaulus (highball-db#661, 2026-10-24), Apple M1, macOS 27.0, Highball 0.10.22, the Wine 11 engine x64-crossover26.3-r27, DXMT, Visual C++ runtimes installed, rated 4 of 5. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Reported playable on the Wine 11 engine with DXMT on an M1. Signing in with a Microsoft account does not work, so capes cannot be redeemed, and everything else is available. The reporter says the sign-in needs an implementation of xgameruntime.dll, Microsoft's Gaming Runtime, which Wine does not have. Nothing was measured here.

knownIssues.symptom: Microsoft account sign-in does not work, so capes cannot be redeemed (reported on an M1, Wine 11 r27, DXMT)
knownIssues.cause: the game wants Microsoft's Gaming Runtime (xgameruntime.dll), which Wine does not provide, by the reporter
knownIssues.fix: none yet. The rest of the game plays without signing in
